tagline: Make every lesson easier with StudyGenie
welcomeBody: AI Tutor, notes, quizzes, and flashcards in one app. You can also install it as a PWA on your phone.
name: Name
loginHint: Log in with your email and password.
signupHint: Fill in your details and start learning.
demoMode: No Supabase keys yet. You can continue with a local demo account.
supabaseReady: Supabase is linked. Real accounts will be saved.
invalidLogin: Email or password is wrong. Please try again.
fillRequired: Please fill in all required fields.
weakPassword: Password must be at least 6 characters.
noQuizYet: You have not tried a quiz yet. Start one next.
tutorHint: Coaching from your results, papers, subjects, and weak areas — not from class.
tutorPlaceholder: Ask about a weak topic, or start from your results...
emptyTutor: StudyGenie looks at your quiz results, uploaded papers, and subjects, then teaches the weak parts.
startFromResultsPrompt: Look at my quiz results, papers, and weak subjects, then teach me the weak parts.
notesHint: Add a topic. Notes use your results and papers too.
notesEmpty: No saved notes yet. Create a new one.
notesSaved: Notes saved. Use them for revision.
quizHint: Practice the subjects you study and the areas you miss.
quizEmpty: Add a topic and generate a quiz.
flashHint: Cards for your weak areas and papers.
flashEmpty: No cards yet. Add a topic and generate some.
uploadsHint: Upload a NIE syllabus or teacher-guide PDF/TXT, then index it for AI. Maximum 8MB. HTML/JS files are blocked.
fileTooBig: That file is over 8MB. Pick a smaller file.
fileTypeBlocked: That file type is not allowed. Use PDF, TXT, MD, DOC, or DOCX.
fileUnsafe: This file looks like HTML or a script. Upload is blocked.
offlineBody: No network. Check your connection and try again. If Home is cached, you can still open it.
installHint: On your phone, open Share / Menu and choose Add to Home Screen.
mockAiBanner: No AI key yet — demo answers will show. Link real AI later.
subjectsHint: Type subjects separated by commas. Ex: Maths, Science, English
teacherHomeHint: Turn an MCQ paper into a private poll link. Classes and students come next.
classesEmpty: No classes yet. Add a new class.
classesHint: Add your classes, then link students and assignments to them.
studentsHint: Pick a class and add a student.
assignmentsHint: Add homework or an assignment to a class.
fileExtractEmpty: No text preview for this file. PDF / TXT / MD can be indexed for AI.
sourceIndexEmpty: No text found in this file. Try a PDF, TXT, or MD file.
dailyQuizPreparing: Today's quiz is being prepared in the background...
dailyQuestionsHint: Add daily questions yourself so several subjects are covered.
dailyQuestionsEmpty: No daily questions yet. Add a new one.
dailyQuizEmptyBank: Today's quiz is not ready yet. Keep the app open for a moment, or add questions in ClassGenie.
subject: Subject
dailyQuizStudentHint: AI prepares today's quiz from your results and papers in the background. It refreshes every day.
dailyQuizOnce: This quiz is once a day. You can't try it again today.
guideLearningHint: Work through the full syllabus step by step. Done topics fill the home donut.
swipeCharts: Swipe sideways for the next slide
noSubjectData: This uses a summary of past papers and model papers.
papersHint: Past and model papers feed the home score and time chart.
pickSubjectYear: Select subject and year to see the paper.
createOwnHint: Type any topic. Example: Science Newton laws feel hard — generate 10 questions. It appears like Daily Quiz.
createOwnPlaceholder: Science Newton laws feel hard. Make 10 questions.
tasksHint: AI looks at your quiz, study, games, and papers, then sets what to do today. Daily Quiz is every day.
taskChangeHint: If you cannot do a task, tell the AI and it will reset the list.
taskChangePlaceholder: Ex: No time for past papers today.
studyHint: Select a subject, then pick a lesson.
wantToLearn: What do you want to talk about?
studyChatHint: Type a question. This is a new chat. Answers use your quizzes, notes, and what you already said here.
studyPlaceholder: Ask anything about what you are studying...
gameHint: Try quick questions like a game.
bioHint: Update name, grade, school medium, and subjects here.
studyMediumHint: In Sri Lanka, subjects are taught in Sinhala, English, or Tamil medium. Pick yours so questions match.
guidedStayHint: If it is unclear, just say so in your own words. Ask anything. The next idea starts only when this one lands.
pollDropHint: Drag and drop a PDF or image, or select one. Max 8MB. We read the MCQs and make a private share link.
pollDropCta: Drop a file here, or select one
pollDropBusy: Reading the questions… this can take a little time.
pollThanks: Vote in. Class poll results are below.
pollNoQuestions: Could not find MCQs in this paper. Check that (1)(2)(3)(4) options are visible, or try a clear photo of one page.
pollExtractFail: Could not read the file. Try again in a bit.
pollFileType: PDF, JPG, PNG, or WEBP only. Max 8MB.
pollPreview: Questions read from the paper. Fix any mistakes here, then make the link.
pollPublicHint: Pick one option for each question, then submit. You will see your vote and the class results.
